name: Minneapolis [Saint Paul]
scopeLimits: Hennepin County assessment parcels on the Minneapolis side of the combined Minneapolis–Saint Paul settlement. Thirteen aligned cells plus four adjacent pans and an expanded 35-view check around the unchanged WUP locator yielded 10 distinct full county parcel geometries. Native EPSG:26915 count and object-ID manifests agreed, forced three-row paging completed, all 10 fresh COUNTY_PIN reads reproduced geometry, and explicit absence, full footprint lookup and complete proposal binding passed. GEOS in EPSG:26915 found no invalid polygons, duplicate geometry, sampled overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. Only OBJECTID transport keys and native COUNTY_PIN identifiers accompany geometry. The exact WUP point returned no parcel; nearby verified polygons remain usable. Hennepin metadata describes taxed, tax-exempt and stacked multi-PID assessment parcels; the small sampled area contains no stacked duplicates, while broader county completeness and topology remain unverified. The endpoint is named Parcels_2025; its current revision and identity continuity after replacement were not established. Saint Paul/Ramsey coverage remains a separate source. Published survey and legal-use notices are retained as scope information.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Hennepin County’s public County Parcels dataset is maintained from parcel geometry created by the County Survey Division and county property-tax data. It provides local parcel GIS, but is an assessor/tax parcel fabric and carries a non-survey/legal-use disclaimer.
remainingUncertainty: Settlement-wide coverage across Minneapolis and Saint Paul requires separate county sources. Only Hennepin County was sampled here. Exact point non-intersection does not establish that the entire source lacks coverage or that no legal parcel exists.
nextStep: Inspect enabled Hennepin source in headed Minneapolis app.

officialSources.observation: Minneapolis GIS page points users to City GIS, Open Data Minneapolis and City of Saint Paul GIS as separate resources.
Minnesota Geospatial Commons identifies the public Hennepin County County Parcels dataset, monthly refresh, and county PIN field; describes stacked multi-PID geometries.

Hennepin County metadata says parcel geometry is created and maintained by Hennepin County Survey Division, combined with county property-tax extracts, and is not suitable for legal, engineering or surveying use.
Metropolitan Council city-boundary layer used to identify exact WUP point as Minneapolis.
Metropolitan Council Hennepin County parcel layer queried with safe field allowlist only.
Official Hennepin County property page lists public property maps, survey plats and maps for download or purchase.

viewerAndServiceTrace.summary: Exact coordinate was queried against a public Metropolitan Council city-boundary layer and Hennepin County parcel layer. The boundary service returned Minneapolis. The parcel service returned no exact-point feature; a bounded 25 m square query returned two nearby polygons. Existing Ramsey County app source is specifically scoped to Saint Paul and is not a match for this Minneapolis point.
viewerAndServiceTrace.geometryStatus: HTTP 200 boundary exact point: Minneapolis; HTTP 200 Hennepin exact parcel point: empty; HTTP 200 25 m envelope: 2 polygons

attemptedGeometry.status: Exact-point parcel query returned empty; 25 m square query returned two polygons
